newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania parliament adopts pyramid scheme control.
newsitem.headline: Albania parliament adopts pyramid scheme control.

text.p: The Albanian parliament passed legislation to regulate the pyramid investment schemes whose collapse pushed the Balkan nation to the brink of anarchy, the Albanian news agency ATA reported on Saturday.
The agency said parliament adopted the controversial legislation on Friday.

Widespread rioting shook Albania in February and March when five of the schemes collapsed and people who had invested their life savings took to the streets. Four other pyramid investment companies are still operating but have stopped paying interest.

The assembly, which is dominated by President Sali Berisha's Democratic Party, had wanted the law to pass control of the five collapsed schemes into the hands of a group of government-appointed financial experts along with the four still operating.

But Finance Minister Arben Malaj, a socialist in the nine-party National Reconciliation government appointed in March, said the collapsed schemes should not be included because they were already being investigated by state prosecutors.
Malaj has said that any government that comes to power after early elections due on June 29 will have to deal with the issue of returning the funds in the schemes that were still afloat.
